generations.zh: 当前代。官方口径五档尺寸：E2B / E4B / 12B / 26B-A4B / 31B；dense 与 MoE 两种架构。
generations.en: Current generation. Officially five sizes: E2B / E4B / 12B / 26B-A4B / 31B, in both dense and MoE architectures.

generations.zh: 上一代，1B–27B 多模态小杯路线；Gemma 4 的许可证与使用政策框架在这一代确立。
generations.en: Previous generation, multimodal small builds from 1B to 27B; the licence-plus-use-policy framework carried into Gemma 4 was established here.

sizeTiers.zh: 端侧 E2B / E4B：手机与浏览器可跑
sizeTiers.en: On-device E2B / E4B: phones and browsers

licenses.zh: Apache-2.0（附 Google 使用政策，链接以官方许可页为准）
licenses.en: Apache-2.0 (subject to Google's use policy; see the official licence page)

claims.zh: 官方 README：「Gemma 4 features a context window of up to 256K tokens and maintains multilingual support in over 140 languages」——中模型 256K、小模型 128K（官方分区口径）。
claims.en: Official README: "Gemma 4 features a context window of up to 256K tokens and maintains multilingual support in over 140 languages" — 256K on medium builds, 128K on small ones per the official breakdown.

claims.zh: 官方 README：多模态覆盖 text + image（全部规格），video 与 audio 在 E2B / E4B / 12B 上原生支持。
claims.en: Official README: multimodal coverage of text + image on all builds, with video and audio native on E2B / E4B / 12B.

positioning.zh: 尺寸档最全的家族（E2B 到 31B），端侧到服务器一条线；许可是 Apache-2.0 + 使用政策组合，下载前读政策原文。本站收录的 gemma-4 系列覆盖其中三档。
positioning.en: The family with the widest size spread (E2B to 31B), one line from edge to server. Licensing is Apache-2.0 plus a use policy — read the policy text before download. This site's gemma-4 series covers three of the tiers.

onSite.zh: 本站已收录 Gemma 4 的量化对比（3 个模型仓 / 30 个量化档）
onSite.en: This site covers Gemma 4 quantisations (3 repos / 30 tiers)
